clips.title: The story
paras: Arachnophobia is a Horde bounty quest targeting Besseleth, an ancient and colossal predator haunting southern Stonetalon Mountains. Posted on a roadside notice near Windshear Crag, the bounty directs adventurers into Sishir Canyon to claim the spider matriarch's fang for Maggran Earthbinder at Sun Rock Retreat. Putting an end to her reign makes the mountain roads safer for night travelers.

Travelers along the main thoroughfare south of Windshear Crag will spot a weathered wanted poster warning of the dangers to the west. Sishir Canyon and Webwinder Path have been completely overrun by eight-legged predators. At the heart of this webbed menace sits Besseleth, an unusually large, orange-hued spider who commands her brood and ambushes anyone daring to stray off the path after sunset.

The bounty on Besseleth is offered by Maggran Earthbinder, a tauren resident of Sun Rock Retreat. Maggran has a personal score to settle with the matriarch: during a previous encounter, he was nearly killed when struck by Besseleth's massive two-foot fang. Though he managed to fight her off and limp to safety, the lingering wound serves as a constant reminder of the danger lurking in the canyon shadows. By having an adventurer claim Besseleth's Fang, Maggran hopes to secure the passes so trade and travel to Sun Rock Retreat can flourish without fear.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Warning: Proceed into Sishir Canyon west of here at your own risk.
Besseleth and her eight-legged children of the forest have claimed this canyon as their webbed lair.

Maggran Earthbinder in Sun Rock Retreat has placed a bounty on Besseleth. Slay her and bring proof of your killing to Maggran; there you will receive your reward for disposing this eight-legged menace.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Besseleth is a ruthless predator... I fear for those that travel Webwinder Path at night. It's then that she and her children prey upon innocent travelers. I myself fell prey to her two-foot fang of death, but luckily I was able to fend her off and get to safety. I would give anything to see that monster destroyed.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Good hunting, friend! Besseleth is an old predator in these parts... I will miss her not. Take this reward as a token for being the forest champion.
Perhaps now many more will travel to Sun Rock Retreat without fearing what lurks in the dark.
